reason: I read labels and a natural 80 mg caffeine drink with nothing added is exactly what I'd rather drink than my daily Monster, and 10 CZK more a can doesn't matter to me. I'd try it once, probably at a café or with a small e-shop order, to see if it actually keeps me going.
objection: It's not where I buy. I grab my energy drink at a petrol station or Albert on the way, and it's not even on Rohlík, so a one-off e-shop order is fine but it won't replace my daily habit unless it's that easy to get.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to add it to my weekly Rohlík order or grab it cold at Albert or Tesco would turn a one-time try into a daily habit.
